predictions.text: I predict that the Student List wins the 2026 Serbian parliamentary election and forms the government.
I predict that the Celebrity Traitors series 2 will conclude with the Traitors team winning the competition, distributing the £100,000 among their chosen charities.
I predict that Saudi Arabia launches its next round of airstrikes in Al Hazm, Al-Jawf Governorate, Yemen, killing 14 civilians and wounding 10.
I predict that further drone strikes will occur in Nyala, Sudan, resulting in over 100 people killed and 112 more injured.
I predict that at least three people will have been killed as Cyclone Arnab makes landfall in Andhra Pradesh, India.
I predict that there will be additional attacks on Israeli embassies in Belgrade, Serbia, by the end of Friday, 6 November 2026.

I predict that the United States will impose additional sanctions on the Rwandan military, targeting specific individuals within the ministry of defence, and this action will be accompanied by a statement from the United States government.

I predict that clashes between armed groups from a prominent country and local resistance groups will continue in the capital city, with at least one skirmish involving both sides by the end of Friday, 6 November 2026.
I predict that the women's championship will be won by Team Sweden and the men's championship will be won by Team Norway, with both teams winning their respective playoffs.
